name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 👑 Hives tab: clearer queen buttons, and a new one, ❔ Not recorded, for hives whose queen hasn't been checked yet.
👑 Replacing a queen asks what happened to the old one: pinched (and why), moved to another hive or nuc, banked, or sold.
🧱 Combining hives by voice: no "whose queen?" question when one hive is queenless, and the hive that went away is kept as Inactive, combined into the other, with all its records.
🐝 Mite counts like "2 in a 300 bee alcohol wash" now keep the 300 bees.
